args: d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -d "$d/.specify/extensions/memory-md" ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; e="$d/.specify/extensions/memory-md"; if [ ! -d "$e" ]; then echo "speckit-memory-hub: memory-md extension not found under $PWD -- run setup-speckit.sh first" >&2; exit 1; fi; b="$e/dist/bin/speckit-memory.js"; if [ ! -f "$b" ]; then echo "speckit-memory-hub: building server in $e" >&2; ( cd "$e" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build ) 1>&2 || { echo "speckit-memory-hub: build failed (need Node.js >=18 + a C toolchain for better-sqlite3)" >&2; exit 1; }; fi; exec node "$b" mcp-start
